sentences.text: MIZORAM
C/O 99 APO

For appellants : Mr. D. Das, Advocate General, Mizoram assisted by Mr. A. Kalita,
Advocate
For respondents : Mr. P.D. Nair, Advocate -BEFORE- HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SOUMITRA SAIKIA 21-03-2023
This application was filed for stay of the operation of the impugned judgment and order dated 15.11.2017 passed by the learned Single Judge in WP(C) No.20/2014 and other connected writ petition.
By the said impugned judgment and order, the respondents were directed to pay compensation to the writ petitioners/respondents herein.

It is stated at the Bar that the writ petitioners/respondents herein have already been paid compensation as per the provisions of the Mizoram (Land Acquisition, Resettlement &
Rehabilitation) Act, 2016.
In view of the submission noted above, this interlocutory application stands closed.
